description: The file defines a PHP class named BuzzCommentDecorator, which provides a decorator/wrapper around the BuzzComment entity class. It includes methods for associating employees and shares, retrieving formatted creation dates/times, checking if the authenticated employee liked a comment, and modifying like counts.

classes.name: BuzzCommentDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that adds additional methods and logic to manipulate and access properties of the BuzzComment entity, including setting related employee and share references, formatting creation dates/times, and handling likes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a BuzzComment entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with the comment based on employee number.

methods.name: setShareById
methods.description: Associates a BuzzShare entity with the comment based on share ID.

methods.name: getCreatedDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted creation date of the comment in 'Y-m-d' format.

methods.name: getCreatedTime
methods.description: Returns the formatted creation time of the comment in 'H:i' format.

methods.name: isAuthEmployeeLiked
methods.description: Checks if the authenticated employee has liked this comment.

methods.name: increaseNumOfLikesByOne
methods.description: Increments the number of likes on the comment by one.

methods.name: decreaseNumOfLikesByOne
methods.description: Decrements the number of likes on the comment by one.
